description: Data layer: add fromFirestore/toFirestore to all 7 model files, then create lib/services/firestore_service.dart implementing the full FirestoreService class. Depends on FEAT-001 (needs firebase_core/cloud_firestore packages resolved). Independent of FEAT-003 (viewmodels/main.dart).
steps:
Edit lib/models/user.dart — add two methods after the existing toMap():

  factory User.fromFirestore(Map<String, dynamic> data) => User(
        id: data['id'] as int,
        name: data['name'] as String,
        email: data['email'] as String,
        password: data['password'] as String,
        phone: data['phone'] as String?,
        avatar: data['avatar'] as String?,
        createdAt: data['createdAt'] as String,
      );

  Map<String, dynamic> toFirestore() => {
        'id': id,
        'name': name,
        'email': email,
        'password': password,
        'phone': phone,
        'avatar': avatar,
        'createdAt': createdAt,
      };

Edit lib/models/court.dart — add two methods after the existing toMap(). NOTE: fromFirestore reads 'images' as List (Firestore array), NOT JSON string. toFirestore() writes images as List<String> (NOT jsonEncoded):

  factory Court.fromFirestore(Map<String, dynamic> data) => Court(
        id: data['id'] as int,
        name: data['name'] as String,
        type: data['type'] as String,
        address: data['address'] as String,
        lat: (data['lat'] as num).toDouble(),
        lng: (data['lng'] as num).toDouble(),
        pricePerHour: (data['pricePerHour'] as num).toDouble(),
        peakPricePerHour: (data['peakPricePerHour'] as num).toDouble(),
        description: data['description'] as String?,
        images: List<String>.from(data['images'] ?? []),
        rating: (data['rating'] as num).toDouble(),
        reviewCount: data['reviewCount'] as int,
      );

  Map<String, dynamic> toFirestore() => {
        'id': id,
        'name': name,
        'type': type,
        'address': address,
        'lat': lat,
        'lng': lng,
        'pricePerHour': pricePerHour,
        'peakPricePerHour': peakPricePerHour,
        'description': description,
        'images': images,
        'rating': rating,
        'reviewCount': reviewCount,
      };

Edit lib/models/booking.dart — add two methods. NOTE: fromFirestore reads 'addons' as Map<String,bool> (Firestore map), NOT JSON string. toFirestore() writes addons as Map<String,bool>:

  factory Booking.fromFirestore(Map<String, dynamic> data) => Booking(
        id: data['id'] as int,
        courtId: data['courtId'] as int,
        userId: data['userId'] as int,
        date: data['date'] as String,
        startTime: data['startTime'] as String,
        endTime: data['endTime'] as String,
        totalPrice: (data['totalPrice'] as num).toDouble(),
        status: data['status'] as String? ?? 'confirmed',
        addons: data['addons'] != null
            ? Map<String, bool>.from(data['addons'] as Map)
            : {},
        createdAt: data['createdAt'] as String,
        courtName: data['courtName'] as String?,
        courtType: data['courtType'] as String?,
      );

  Map<String, dynamic> toFirestore() => {
        'id': id,
        'courtId': courtId,
        'userId': userId,
        'date': date,
        'startTime': startTime,
        'endTime': endTime,
        'totalPrice': totalPrice,
        'status': status,
        'addons': addons,
        'createdAt': createdAt,
        if (courtName != null) 'courtName': courtName,
        if (courtType != null) 'courtType': courtType,
      };

Edit lib/models/time_slot.dart — add two methods. NOTE: fromFirestore reads 'isAvailable' as bool (Firestore boolean), NOT int 0/1:

  factory TimeSlot.fromFirestore(Map<String, dynamic> data) => TimeSlot(
        id: data['id'] as int,
        courtId: data['courtId'] as int,
        date: data['date'] as String,
        startTime: data['startTime'] as String,
        endTime: data['endTime'] as String,
        isAvailable: data['isAvailable'] as bool,
      );

  Map<String, dynamic> toFirestore() => {
        'id': id,
        'courtId': courtId,
        'date': date,
        'startTime': startTime,
        'endTime': endTime,
        'isAvailable': isAvailable,
      };

Edit lib/models/message.dart — add two methods. NOTE: fromFirestore reads 'isFromUser' as bool:

  factory Message.fromFirestore(Map<String, dynamic> data) => Message(
        id: data['id'] as int,
        courtId: data['courtId'] as int,
        userId: data['userId'] as int,
        isFromUser: data['isFromUser'] as bool,
        text: data['text'] as String,
        timestamp: data['timestamp'] as String,
      );

  Map<String, dynamic> toFirestore() => {
        'id': id,
        'courtId': courtId,
        'userId': userId,
        'isFromUser': isFromUser,
        'text': text,
        'timestamp': timestamp,
      };

Edit lib/models/app_notification.dart — add two methods. NOTE: fromFirestore reads 'isRead' as bool:

  factory AppNotification.fromFirestore(Map<String, dynamic> data) => AppNotification(
        id: data['id'] as int,
        userId: data['userId'] as int,
        title: data['title'] as String,
        body: data['body'] as String,
        type: data['type'] as String,
        isRead: data['isRead'] as bool,
        createdAt: data['createdAt'] as String,
        bookingId: data['bookingId'] as int?,
      );

  Map<String, dynamic> toFirestore() => {
        'id': id,
        'userId': userId,
        'title': title,
        'body': body,
        'type': type,
        'isRead': isRead,
        'createdAt': createdAt,
        if (bookingId != null) 'bookingId': bookingId,
      };

Critical detail for getChattedCourts: Court.fromMap expects snake_case keys and 'images' as a JSON-encoded string. Build the returned map like this:
  {
    'id': court.id,
    'name': court.name,
    'type': court.type,
    'address': court.address,
    'lat': court.lat,
    'lng': court.lng,
    'price_per_hour': court.pricePerHour,
    'peak_price_per_hour': court.peakPricePerHour,
    'description': court.description,
    'images': jsonEncode(court.images),
    'rating': court.rating,
    'review_count': court.reviewCount,
    'last_message': lastMsg['text'],
    'last_timestamp': lastMsg['ts'],
  }
Wrap every public method body in try/catch: catch (e) { debugPrint('FirestoreService.methodName error: $e'); rethrow; }
Run: flutter analyze lib/models/ and flutter analyze lib/services/firestore_service.dart — fix all errors before marking complete.
acceptance_criteria: All 7 model files have fromFirestore(Map<String,dynamic>) factory and toFirestore() method
TimeSlot.fromFirestore reads isAvailable as bool (not int)
Booking.fromFirestore reads addons as Map<String,bool> (not JSON string)
Court.fromFirestore reads images as List<String> (not JSON string)
lib/services/firestore_service.dart exists with all methods from DatabaseService (same signatures)
FirestoreService is a singleton (factory constructor pattern)
_seedCourtsIfEmpty uses batch commits with max 400 ops per batch
_getSeedCourts returns the same 15 courts as in database_service.dart
getChattedCourts returns snake_case maps with jsonEncoded 'images' string
flutter analyze lib/models/ and flutter analyze lib/services/firestore_service.dart report zero errors
